content:
To this day, unusual objects continue to be observed in the Martian atmosphere. Some have been interpreted as possible UFOs or other unknown phenomena moving through Martian airspace. While there is no confirmed evidence that these objects represent intelligent life, their presence has raised questions about what may still exist on or beneath the surface of Mars. 

The next image was captured by the Right Navigation Camera aboard NASA’s Curiosity rover on Sol 3924, corresponding to August 20, 2023, at 22:27:46 UTC. 

It appears to show a strange entity in the Martian sky resembling a tripod-like or jellyfish-like life form, seemingly interacting with the surface below. 

Coincidence? The entity's appearance is remarkably similar to the tripod-like creatures depicted in War of the Worlds and the heptapod-like beings featured in Arrival. There may be more happening on Mars than NASA is telling us. 

Kari Sivertzen, who discovered the jellyfish-like object, as well as Joe White, Scott Waring and Jean Ward also identified several other possible UFO's in images of the Martian sky. According to their analysis, these UFO's appear to be more than simple camera artifacts or dust particles on the lens. 

In the next video, Jean Ward examines the mysterious entity and UFO's in greater detail.
